subject.title: fix(claude-cli): max-turn stops omit run and recovery context

question: Should verified Claude CLI max-turn outcomes be terminal and non-replayable when the result indicates tool actions may already have run?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but the fallback-availability versus duplicate-side-effect tradeoff is intentional runtime policy that maintainers should explicitly own.

options.title: Keep terminal non-replay
options.body: Require users to verify possible tool effects before retrying, preventing automatic duplicate execution.

options.title: Retain automatic fallback
options.body: Keep profile and model replay availability while accepting that completed tool effects may be repeated.

recommendation.title: Keep terminal non-replay
recommendation.body: Require users to verify possible tool effects before retrying, preventing automatic duplicate execution.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work establishes the shared CLI terminal-state behavior across both affected runner paths.
